findings.title: ValueError 构造参数错误导致异常消息格式异常
findings.explanation: raise ValueError("Invalid max_wbits value %r; allowed range 8-%d", max_wbits, zlib.MAX_WBITS) 将格式字符串和参数作为多个位置参数传给 ValueError，而不是用 % 运算符格式化。结果 ValueError.args 是三元组，str(e) 会显示为元组字面量 "('Invalid max_wbits value %r; allowed range 8-%d', 7, 15)"，而不是预期的格式化消息。
findings.trigger: 构造 _PerMessageDeflateCompressor(persistent=False, max_wbits=7)，触发 728 行条件，捕获异常并 str(e)。
findings.evidence:
729-733 行：raise ValueError(
    "Invalid max_wbits value %r; allowed range 8-%d",
    max_wbits,
    zlib.MAX_WBITS,
) 缺少 % (max_wbits, zlib.MAX_WBITS)。
findings.suggestion: 改为 raise ValueError("Invalid max_wbits value %r; allowed range 8-%d" % (max_wbits, zlib.MAX_WBITS))。
findings.snippet:
727:         # There is no symbolic constant for the minimum wbits value.
728:         if not (8 <= max_wbits <= zlib.MAX_WBITS):
729:             raise ValueError(
730:                 "Invalid max_wbits value %r; allowed range 8-%d",
731:                 max_wbits,
732:                 zlib.MAX_WBITS,
733:             )
734:         self._max_wbits = max_wbits
735:
